source_pdf.title: LightJudge 지식 증류 성능 및 시간 효율성 연구보고서

new_primary: adaptive_hard minus adaptive_soft final-test generation accuracy
supporting_ci_scope: Prespecified exploratory, unadjusted 95% intervals; not additional confirmatory primary tests.

soft_gate_plan.margin_evidence: Reported best ablation value in CaRE-KD section 4.5; not asserted to be the default for every original experiment or optimal on ARC.
soft_gate_plan.temperature_selection: Not applicable; no division by gate temperature in Eq.3. Equivalent unit slope is an algebraic observation, not a separately reported hyperparameter.
soft_gate_plan.scope_difference: Paper gate applied to existing ARC first-answer T=2 full-vocabulary KL plus shared EOS; Revival/BALD are absent.
soft_gate_plan.status: All three Soft seeds completed training and final validation; Eq.3 gates verified; all 23 models sealed and test evaluation started.
soft_gate_plan.replication_claim: Application of literal public Eq.3 and Eq.7, not verified exact reproduction of experimental code scaling.

time_to_accuracy_plan.reason: No ARC standard or cited paper justification for 80%; continuous observed accuracy-time tradeoff is primary instead.

active_efficiency_plan.fixed_seed42_replay: Matched timing/curve replay in shared desktop environment; never replaces existing final checkpoint.

correction_2026_10_12.reason: User requested paper-supported settings instead of an ad hoc gate temperature.
correction_2026_10_12.removed_unexecuted_proposal: median absolute confidence gap / ln(3) gate temperature and detached soft gate

source_policy: Every new numerical setting needs a source or explicitly documented control/measurement justification; method citations do not establish numerical defaults.
training_stage_boundary: Training driver ends after all 21 final validations; connected evaluation process waits, verifies all cells, seals 23 models and evaluates, analyzes and publishes. No heartbeat or scheduled task.
reuse_status: 13 completed training runs and 12 final validation outputs verified and frozen as v4 references
timing_limit: Desktop GPU workload not isolated; observed times retained without attributing differences to algorithm alone.
